summary.name: ImgUpscaler
summary.one_liner: An online AI image upscaler that enlarges photos, anime art, product images, portraits and old pictures by 2x or 4x, with a desktop app (Upscal) also mentioned.
use_cases: enlarge low-resolution photos for print or web
restore and enlarge old or scanned pictures
prepare thumbnails and social media images
batch upscale campaign or client image sets
summary.what_it_does: The site offers AI super-resolution that enlarges images by 2x or 4x and aims to produce sharper edges, cleaner textures and more natural detail. The workflow is upload, choose ratio, preview the before/after comparison, then download. Free use covers single-image upscaling, while paid plans add batch processing for multiple images. Uploaded files and results are said to be deleted automatically within 24 hours, and outputs may be used for personal or commercial projects. A separate desktop product, Upscal, is described as offline and batch-capable.
notable: Uploads and results auto-deleted within 24 hours
Desktop app Upscal for offline batch upscaling
caveats: Batch processing requires a paid plan
Free tier appears limited to single-image upscaling
Upscal desktop app platforms not specified on the page
